summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing its ongoing share buy-back programme, first announced on 5 August 2026, with 314,800 shares purchased on 21 August 2026 across UK venues and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Consideration ranged from US$15.19 to US$15.20 per share (UK) and HK$160.40 to HK$163.80 (HK). Since inception, 18,283,014 shares have been repurchased for approximately US$376.8 million. Repurchased shares are cancelled, reducing issued share capital. The buy-back is executed on-exchange via BNP Paribas. Watch for continued daily buy-back announcements and remaining programme size.
